What it does

  • Shows a measured number. This week's visitors so far, counted by our script on your own site — the same figure as on your project page, never an estimate or an upvote.
  • Lives in your page as text. No image, no iframe: it follows the reader's zoom and theme, reads fine in screen readers, and links to your project page with a normal, followed link.
  • Never bluffs. While nothing is measured it says "measuring paused"; the dot lights up when the script has just reported a pageview.
